email_source.name: Outlook Email
email_source.note: Scans Outlook mail via Graph Mail.Read for WW-window updates. Requires the cached refresh token to include Mail.Read (re-seed via IRE-SharePoint.ps1 -Action GetToken if a scope/403 warning appears).

calendar_source.name: Outlook Calendar
calendar_source.note: Reads meeting contents from the LOCAL Outlook client via COM (pywin32) - NO Graph Calendars.Read permission needed. Requires desktop Outlook + pywin32. Scans the WW window plus lookahead_days of upcoming meetings.
